wounds._source: ACE medical_damage config ACE_Medical_Injuries; damage/inflictInternalBleeding; breathing/generatePTXMap
wounds._internal: chance for [medium, large]; + lin(partDamage 2..4 -> 0..0.5) capped 0.8; x setting internalBleedingChanceMultiplier
wounds._chest: [minDamage, minChance, maxDamage, maxChance] linear; x chestInjuryChance; hemothoraxChance (0.2) picks HTX

IV.special: induces asystole above 0.9 count; restarts in target rhythm below 0.5 (VT->sinus)
in VF/pVT every 12-16 s chance 0.4 (VF) / 0.5 (pVT) x (count/2)/0.9 of ROSC; adds to CPR medication factor

Atropine.special: count>=3: sarin buildup -2*count/3 per 20-30 s (half in CA), spasm mitigated; count>=4: may clear spasm

IM.special: local anesthetic per body part: IO pain (0.24 count -> 95 %), thoracostomy/realignment (>=0.7 none, <0.5 conscious knocked out for thoracostomy), IM injection pain (<0.5)

IV.special: bleeding x lin(0.5..2 count): ext ->0.9, internal/capillary ->0.85, hemothorax ->0.8; platelet loss x0.9; recovery x2; starts clotting loops

Ertapenem.special: required (>=0.9 count) before casualty conversion when ACM_evacuation_requireAntibiotics

Dimercaprol.special: lewisite buildup -8*min(count,2) per 20-30 s (half in CA); item hidden in 1.4.8

INHALE.special: wake chance lin(SpO2 80..99 -> 0.5..1) if stable vitals; 10 s cooldown
removes Overdose_Opioid and all Opioid-type adjustments

pharmacology._source: core/ov/medicationLocal, onMedicationUsage, circulation/getMedicationEffect, handleOverdose, isOverdosed, getCardiacMedicationEffects
pharmacology.weightScaling: full and min doses x bodyWeight / 83 when weightBased
pharmacology.tourniquetOcclusion: drugs into a limb with a tourniquet are held until removal, except IV via IO in an arm

cpr._source: circulation/beginCPR, handleCPR, AED_AdministerShock, handleCardiacArrest, handleReversibleCardiacArrest, attemptROSC

aed.directRosc: only if shock-resistant (30 % per shock) and amiodarone effect > 1.9: chance = CPR(60..120 s -> 0..10) + 0.2 + 0.2*amio

codeNotes: rhythm deterioration never triggers (inverted time check)
pausing CPR ends the 5 s roll loop until CPR is restarted

breathing.ncdOnNonTension: PTX level 3 if no chest seal

cbrn._bands: band = thresholds[firstIndex(>buildup) - 1]; above the last threshold the modifier is 1 (code)
